about_pillar_1_body: From frame geometry to firmware, every Joyor scooter is developed by our own engineering team. We own the design, the tooling, and the production line, so we own the quality.
about_pillar_2_body: Each model is tested across thousands of kilometres in real-world urban and off-road conditions before it ships. Range, braking, and durability are measured, not marketed.
about_pillar_3_body: Local warehouses, local spare parts, and a European service network mean shorter waits, fewer borders, and a scooter that keeps moving long after the first ride.

heritage_title: One factory. One standard. One ride at a time.
heritage_p1: Joyor was founded with a simple idea: that an electric scooter should feel as carefully considered as the city you ride it in. More than a decade later, that conviction still shapes everything we make.
heritage_p2: Our manufacturing campus houses frame welding, battery assembly, motor integration, and quality inspection under one roof. Owning the full production line lets us hold every part to the same standard — and trace every scooter back to the hand that built it.
cookies_meta_desc: Cookie policy — what cookies we use and why.
cookies_what_are_text: Cookies are small text files that are placed on your device when you visit a website. They are widely used to make websites work more efficiently and to provide information to the website operators.
cookies_we_use_text: This website uses only technically necessary cookies that are essential for the basic functionality of the site. We do not use any tracking, analytics, or advertising cookies.
cookies_cf_bm_purpose: Cloudflare bot management — distinguishes humans from bots
cookies_third_party_text: When you click through to our online store (joyorprime.com powered by Shopify), Shopify may set its own cookies. These cookies are governed by {link}.
cookies_managing_text: You can control and delete cookies through your browser settings. Please note that disabling cookies may affect the functionality of this website. Most browsers allow you to:
cookies_manage_1: View what cookies are stored and delete them individually
cookies_manage_5: Delete all cookies when you close your browser
cookies_legal_basis_text: The use of technically necessary cookies is based on our legitimate interest in providing a secure and functional website (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR). Since we do not use non-essential cookies, no separate consent is required.
cookies_contact_text: If you have questions about our use of cookies, please contact us at {email}.
versand_meta_desc: Shipping, returns and refund policy — delivery times, costs, and how to handle issues.
versand_scooters_text: We stock electric scooters in warehouses across Europe (including Germany, Poland, and other locations) and the United States. Most orders are delivered within 2–5 business days via DPD, DHL, or GLS (Europe) and UPS or FedEx (US). Shipping is free.
versand_parts_text: We ship accessories worldwide. Most accessories are shipped from our warehouse in China, with an estimated delivery time of 6–15 business days after dispatch. Selected accessories may ship from our European or US warehouses, in which case delivery typically takes 2–5 business days. Shipping is free on all accessory orders.
versand_general_text: All orders are dispatched within 2 business days of payment confirmation. Tracking information is typically provided on the same day as dispatch.
versand_disclaimer: Delivery times are estimates and may vary due to customs clearance or carrier delays.
versand_before_text: address changes and order cancellations are free of charge. Please contact us as soon as possible.
versand_after_text: we will attempt to update your address with the carrier, but changes cannot be guaranteed once the parcel is in transit. If an address change fails, please refuse the delivery so the parcel can be returned to us.
versand_return_quality: Quality issue or wrong item sent
versand_return_quality_text: Full refund or replacement. Photo or video evidence is required.
versand_return_wrong_text: Refund processed after resale. Return shipping is at the buyer's cost.
versand_return_delayed_text: Eligible for reshipment or full refund.
versand_contact_text: For any shipping or order enquiries, please reach out to us. We respond within 24 hours on business days.
